author: RandPaul
text:
Every year Congress declines to act, the consequences land on somebody else. On the border towns. On the emergency rooms. On the legal immigrant who spent a decade and a small fortune doing it the right way.

I have consistently said the answer starts with enforcement and ends with incentives. It’s time to stop the taxpayer-funded benefits. My End Welfare for Non-Citizens Act does that.
